category_title: Grade 1 students who resist collaboration and require one-to-one guidance
minimal_context: Kylie and her partner are looking for relationships between areas and recording statements using uppercase letters.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Please work with your partner to look for relationships between the areas and record your statements using uppercase letters.

STUDENT: (Sits next to her partner but works independently without discussion) I wrote my equation. It says t+e+L=r.

TUTOR: Examine your work. Remember we need to use uppercase letters.

STUDENT: (Erases the first letter) I rewrote my equation as T+e+L=r.

TUTOR: Work together with your partner to finish correcting the rest of the letters.

STUDENT: (Passively watches as her partner points to the paper without explaining) He just told me to write T+E+L=R, so I'm just going to copy that.

options.A: Terminate the task demands and remove the math materials for 10 seconds.
options.B: Provide visuals, such as videos, computer programs, and pictures.
options.C: Withhold attention from the student during the paired work activity.
options.D: Prompt more engagement by posing a direct question to the student.
